meta.name: frame-macos-notification
meta.description: 拟真 macOS 通知 banner + app icon + 标题正文, 适合 video overlay / 产品发布预告

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成拟真 macOS 通知横幅，用于视频叠加或产品预告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或演示中模拟 macOS 系统通知效果
copy.tagline_en: Generate realistic macOS notification banners for video overlays or product teasers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate macOS notification banners in videos or demos

howto.what: 将用户提供的标题和正文生成为 macOS 风格拟真通知横幅,输出单文件 HTML,包含毛玻璃背景、App 图标、应用名和时间,也支持暗色版。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作 macOS 通知横幅,或把公告/提示渲染成通知样式用于视频叠加时。

say.text: 把这个公告做成 macOS 通知横幅,标题和正文用我给的。
用 Music 做通知横幅,标题‘播放中’,正文‘波西米亚狂想曲’。
say.note: 得到带 App 名、标题和正文的横幅。

say.text: 做一个暗色系 macOS 通知,标题‘系统更新’,正文‘重启后生效’。
say.note: 输出暗色磨砂玻璃版本。

howto.what_en: Claude renders a macOS-style notification banner (single-file HTML) from the user's title/body, including frosted glass, app icon, app name, and time; dark mode available.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to make a macOS notification-style banner, or wants an announcement/prompt rendered as a notification overlay for video.

say_en.text: Turn my message into a macOS notification banner with the title and body I gave.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the banner as single-file HTML.

say_en.text: Make a Music notification banner, title 'Playing', body 'Bohemian Rhapsody'.
say_en.note: You'll get a banner with app name, title, and body.

say_en.text: Make a dark macOS notification, title 'System Update', body 'Restart to apply'.
